syllabus_extract: Basic concept of ECM. Principle of Jamming used as ECM aid.
specific_objectives: 18.1.4.1 Trainee will be able to appraise the function of secondary radars in ASW operation.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Review of secondary radar ASW function diagrams; Safety: No live equipment; Supervision: Instructor monitors diagram interpretation.
intro_questions: What is the primary function of a radar system?
Define the term Electronic Counter Measures (ECM).
How does a secondary radar assist in Anti-Submarine Warfare?

topics: Role of secondary radars in ASW
Impact of jamming on detection range
development.content:
Definition of Electronic Counter Measures
Distinction between ECCM and ECM
Role of secondary radars in ASW
Basic jamming principles
Impact of jamming on detection range

Types of jamming signals
Mechanism of noise jamming
Mechanism of deception jamming
Secondary radar pulse compression
Analysis of ASW radar vulnerability

Evaluation of jamming effectiveness
Counter-measures against jamming
Integration of secondary radar data
Operational scenarios for ECM
Summary of ECM concepts

summary_questions: Explain how jamming affects the secondary radar's ability to detect submarines.
Describe one method used to counteract jamming in ASW operations.
Differentiate between the function of primary and secondary radars in ECM contexts.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note on how the principles of jamming discussed in this lesson will be expanded upon in the Basic concept of ECCM lesson (LP 12).

pft_rows.syllabus: Basic concept of ECCM. Various methods of ECCM employed by Indian Naval aircraft viz. frequency agility PRF jittering etc
